newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
About 10,000 people came to Vavuniya from north in past week after army lifted restrictions on entry.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga to meet Sri Lanka Moslem Congress politburo after talks with leader M.H.M. Ashraff to sort out differences.
LTTE rebels attack army detachment in Batticaloa district, two soldiers wounded.
Two senior LTTE members shot dead in Paris by unidentified gunman.
Government sends more than 4,700 refugees to resettle in Jaffna.
LTTE said to be losing sympathy of Tamils overseas.
Security forces foil LTTE plan to send 35 suicide bombers to Colombo.
Anura Bandaranaike and Gamini Atukorale emerge as rivals to United National Party leader Ranil Wickremasinghe.
